# Synthetic knowledge base for the server graph

> Three made-up entries for the mcp_kb tests.

## FORMATS

- [The build ledger](formats/formats-ledger.md): The build ledger holds one row per numbered build.
- [The numbers manifest](formats/formats-manifest.md): The numbers manifest maps each placeholder key to the output that produced it.

## LOOP

- [The review loop](loop/loop-review.md): The scholar reviews each build in Word and hands it back.
